user.title: Find Your School
user.description:
**Paste a link to your school's Nutrislice menu.** This is the most reliable way, because Nutrislice web addresses often don't match the district's name.

Don't have the link? Open [Nutrislice Lookup]({lookup_url}), search for your school, open its menu page, then copy the address from your browser and paste it below.

Alternatively, if you know your district's name, search for it instead.

data.link: Link to your school's Nutrislice menu

data_description.district: For example Souderton or Fairfax County Public Schools. Only works when the district's web address resembles its name.

school.title: Select School
school.description:
Found {count} school(s) in {districts}. Select your school below.

If it isn't listed, go back and paste a link to your school's Nutrislice menu instead.

menu_types.title: Select Menus to Track
menu_types.description: Choose which meal menus you want to track for {school_name}:

data.title_sections: Show in calendar titles and sensors

data_description.title_sections: Each course you tick is added to calendar event titles and to the Today and Tomorrow sensors, led by its emoji. With only Entrees ticked they read like: Cheeseburger, Pizza. Tick none to show just the meal name. The full menu is always in the event description and the sensor attributes.

error.nothing_entered: Enter a link to your school's Nutrislice menu, or a district name to search for.
error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a Nutrislice menu link, or the district in it no longer exists. Open your school's menu on Nutrislice and copy the address from your browser.
error.invalid_district: Could not find a valid Nutrislice district.
error.no_districts_found: No Nutrislice district matched that name. Many districts use a web address unrelated to their name, so try pasting a link to your school's menu instead.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Nutrislice servers.
error.no_menu_types_selected: Please select at least one meal menu to track.

abort.already_configured: This school is already configured in Home Assistant.

data.next_school_day_on_weekend: Show the next school day when tomorrow has no menu
data.title_sections: Show in calendar titles and sensors

data_description.sync_calendar: Optional. Copy upcoming meals as all-day events into another calendar, such as a Local Calendar or Google Calendar. Leave empty to turn off. Events already synced are not changed or removed.
data_description.title_sections: Each course you tick is added to calendar event titles and to the Today and Tomorrow sensors, led by its emoji. With only Entrees ticked they read like: Cheeseburger, Pizza. Tick none to show just the meal name. The full menu is always in the event description and the sensor attributes. Changing this doesn't rewrite meals already synced to another calendar.
data_description.next_school_day_on_weekend: Weekends, holidays, and breaks have no menu. When on, the Tomorrow sensor shows the next day that does, and sets its is_next_school_day attribute to true. When off, it reads No Menu Scheduled.

sync_calendar.name: Sync calendar
sync_calendar.description: Copy upcoming meals into each school's configured sync calendar now, instead of waiting for the next menu update.
